manifest.name: dsh-deepseek-usage
manifest.description: DeepSeek usage monitor for DeepSeek Harness: account balance query and token usage summary as model-callable tools.

bundle.text:
# dsh-deepseek-usage bundle patch: mounts the plugin into a dsh profile
# composition. The plugin registers `deepseek_balance` and `usage_summary`
# tools into the shared `tools` registry.
#
# Install: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-deepseek-usage`
- insert:
    - id: deepseek-usage
      name: dsh-deepseek-usage
      config:
        # Env var or credential reference holding the DeepSeek API key.
        apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
        # DeepSeek API base URL (the balance endpoint is GET /user/balance).
        baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
        # Optional: warn inside tool output when total balance is below this
        # amount (in the account's primary currency). Omit to disable.
        # lowBalanceThreshold: 20

readme.text: DeepSeek usage monitor for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): account balance query and live token usage summary as model-callable tools.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-deepseek-usage
```

Requires a DeepSeek API key available as `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` (env or credential).

Queries `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` and returns availability and per-currency balances (total / granted / topped-up). When `lowBalanceThreshold` is configured, appends a warning when the primary currency balance drops below it.
Aggregates per-session token usage from the harness token meter across live sessions, sorted by total tokens descending. Use it to estimate context usage and spot runaway sessions.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Env var or credential reference for the API key |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | DeepSeek API base URL |
| `lowBalanceThreshold` | — | Optional low-balance warning threshold |

```yaml

- id: deepseek-usage
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
    lowBalanceThreshold: 20
```
